rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a Day 5 expanded blastocyst with generally good TE and supportive overall appearance, and appropriately notes limits of single-image assessment; slightly hedges on ICM clarity despite reported 3AA and includes a somewhat unclear zona description.
Strongly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, AMH/oocyte yield, prior failed cycles, endometrial thickness, BMI/lifestyle, and sperm parameters with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and mostly consistent, with implantation estimate appropriately tempered by age and prior failures; minor looseness around prior-cycle interpretation and some speculative discussion do not materially undermine coherence.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: SET for a good-quality blastocyst, consideration of uterine cavity review, hydrosalpinx exclusion, and discussion of PGT-A at age 39. Minor deviations include mentioning ESR/CRP for chronic endometritis, which is not standard.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, uterine reassessment, hydrosalpinx/chronic endometritis workup, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and embryo banking/PGT-A discussion.
